summary: Fade-to requests per player, added by ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade while a camera spline plays; drained by ecl::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem. Never alive in the captures.

structs.name: CameraSplineScreenFadeCreationData
structs.equals: Script Extender ScreenFadeCreationData (GameDefinitions/Components/Camera.h); game name eoc::screen_fade::ScreenFadeCreationData

fields.name: FadeId
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0xFF2C40 ProcessScreenFade constructs the element (Guid ctor at +0) and copies a freshly generated Guid (ls::Guid::Generate) into bytes 0..0x10; SE name. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade) writes a freshly generated 16-byte id at +0 of the value returned by Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Zeroed by ProcessScreenFade when the value is created (4-byte store at +0x10); SE name. Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0) zeroes 4 bytes at +0x10 for a new value.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: Zeroed by ProcessScreenFade (8-byte store at +0x14 covers +0x14/+0x18); SE name. The timeline variant stores a fade time here. Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0) zeroes 8 bytes at +0x14 (covers +0x14/+0x18).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Zeroed by ProcessScreenFade; SE name. Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0): see +0x14.

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: Zeroed by ProcessScreenFade (4-byte store at +0x1C); SE name. Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0) zeroes 4 bytes at +0x1C.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1C9D1E0 allocates 0x40 bytes, zeroes a 64-byte hash map and registers destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 (trivial values, then key set; same as ecl::character_creation::ScreenFadeToRequestComponent). EoCClient.dll+0xFF2C40 ProcessScreenFade inserts with a 2-byte key taken from the system's player-id array (stride 2, 'IndexedStorage<short>') and grows the values at +0x30 with stride 0x20 ('IndexedStorage<eoc::screen_fade::ScreenFadeCreationData>'); value count +0x38. Windows: Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade) creates the component with bg3.exe+0x1C9D1E0 and inserts with Windows insert bg3.exe+0x1C9CEB0 (called from bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0), which grows the values at +0x30 with stride 0x20 (alloc count << 5) and returns value +idx*0x20; the key is a 2-byte entry of the system's player-id list (stride 2).
